description: Inspect captured session usage and the tool's configured monthly extrapolation and quota assumptions. These estimates do not establish Sentry ingestion, current plan limits or an actual bill. Check the account's current terms and usage before making cost decisions.

deviceId.description: The device to act on: its id from list_devices or from your instructions. Pass it whenever more than one app may be connected. Once a call names a device, later calls in this session use it when deviceId is left out.
